name: ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 11

function.text: ABCB11 encodes bile salt export pump. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity. It participates in cholesterol homeostasis and lipid homeostasis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis type 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
